name: Quill
description: A triton cartographer caught in events far larger than he ever anticipated.
notes: Carries a raw, volatile crystal within his chest.

name: Balthrum Hardbreaker
description: A dwarven warrior whose answer to most problems is considerably more destructive than necessary, especially if that problem is an elf.
quote: If there's one thing I can't stand, its unjustified racism.

name: Mari
description: A quick-witted thief with ties to a strange diety known to be somewhat untrustworthy.
notes: Known member of the Thieves' Guild, based out of the Amber Coast.

name: Caedes Mortem
description: A tiefling necromancer traveling alongside the party, influenced by his Book of Necromancy.

name: Vera
description: A mysterious but friendly owl accompanying Mari.
notes: Has magical properties allowing her to communicate with whoever she bonds to.

name: Jorovindr
description: A monk whose journey has become entangled with the fight against Var'Kennan.

name: Oliver Markford
description: A former pirate who has repeatedly found himself closer to danger than intended.

name: Maria Blasco
description: A bubbly blood hunter from another world, travelling the continent to save her brother.
quote: It`s your birthday. This must be the kindest atom arrangement you`ve ever seen standing in front of you with your cake. You have 2.35 billion beats of your heart left, and each one spent with your brother is the greatest gift the universe has ever given you.

name: Grimsley Perchunt
description: A con-artist cleric who knows his way around weak-willed individuals.

name: Ashton
description: A child of Var'Kennan, on the run from his past and frequently apprehended.
notes: Has a connection to Quill's crystal by unknown means.

name: Dyra
description: A faceless mercenary, relentlessly pursuing Ashton and the party.

name: Bix
description: A talented magic caster descended from Var'Kennan.
notes: Has a connection to Quill's crystal, and is known to manipulate it.

name: "Him"
description: [REDACTED]

name: "The Girl"
description: A mysterious figure whose origins and intentions are unclear.

name: Var'Kennan
description: The God of Flames and Fate. A malevolent ruler whose army of children terrorize the island.
notes: Father of Ashton and Bix, some of the few Flamechildren that the players have encountered so far.

name: Vae'Saron
description: The God of Life and Land. A heavy partier who is omnipresent through the flora of the island.

name: Wintheria
description: The elusive Goddess of Seas and Storms, occasionally encountered along the coasts of the island. Her storms bring a swift end to anyone who wanders far from the shore.

name: Nihleia
description: The Goddess of Souls. Hardly anyone knows what she looks like, or where she resides. Believes in the sanctity of life and death.

name: The Figure
description: The Patron of the Thieves' Guild, in search of gold, glory, and a second life.

name: Wanderer Jumir
description: The Patron of the Stone Giants. Presumed dead or captured by Var'Kennan.

name: Book of Necromancy
description: Caedes' seemingly sentient Book of Necromancy. It searches for a new vessel, in exchange for giving Caedes power and magic.

name: Woodrow Blackwell
description: A friendly fixer based out of Wigston, well regarded among criminals and thieves with his moral compass intact.

name: Voltegar Havensworth
description: A formidable scholar who studies magical runes, trusted by Woodrow.

name: Cody Blasco
description: Maria's older brother, whose family took her in after an incident regarding both of her parents. A kind, perpetually tired guy with a hankering for raw meat and severe magical amnesia.
notes: The team recovered Cody from prison during their heist on High Camorant, but he seems to have been heavily affected by memory modification magic.

name: Glim Leeyoon
description: A Waxborn who has ventured far from her creator in search of purpose and joy.
notes: Glim has split from the party to discover her origins in Homeward Reach.
